subject: general
question:
Seven women A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a row facing the South (not necessarily in the same order). A is fifth to the right of G. A is at one of the ends. E is exactly in the middle of row. F is fourth to the right of G. B is not the immediate neighbour of E. D is to the immediate left of E.

Which of the following statements is/are NOT correct?

I. D is third to the left of F.

II. F is sitting between C and D.
solution:
**Seven women:** A, B, C, D, E, F and G

The pattern followed here is:

1) A is fifth to the right of G. A is at one of the ends.
